### Observed differences

- A06 changed from a rare to a common, early step: in the earlier window it appeared in about 17 in 100 traces (mean 0.17 occurrences per trace, mean relative position about 0.51, i.e. mid-trace); in the later window it appears in about 72 in 100 traces (mean 0.77 occurrences, mean relative position about 0.18). It now also co-occurs with A14, A15, A20, A21, A22, A24, A25, A29, A33, A34 and A44 in about 72 in 100 traces, where previously about 17 in 100, and it precedes A15 and the A20–A25 activities in about 65 in 100 of those traces (previously about 9 in 100). [OCC002, POS001, REL001, REL002, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL008, REL009, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016]

- In the later window A06 typically sits between A14 and A15. About 67 in 100 of A14's outgoing transitions now go to A06 (previously about 2 in 100, when about 87 in 100 went to A15), and about 89 in 100 of A06's outgoing transitions go to A15 (previously about 12 in 100). A14 is immediately followed by A06 in about 96 in 100 of the observed pairs (13 observations before vs 138 after), and the direct one-step A14→A15 succession fell from about 41 in 100 to about 16, while a two-step gap rose to about 37 in 100. [DIR002, DIR004, LAG003, LAG004, REL001, REL002]

- The order of two later blocks reversed. Before, the A20/A21/A22/A24/A25 block (mean relative position about 0.40) was followed by A29 (about 0.49), A33 (about 0.67) and A19/A23/A26/A27/A28 (about 0.68–0.71); for example A20 preceded A29 in about 97 in 100 traces. In the later window the tail activities run earlier (A19/A23/A26–A28 about 0.35, A29 about 0.38, A33 about 0.56), the A20–A25 block runs later (about 0.65), and the pairwise orders are almost completely reversed (A29 precedes A20 in about 99 in 100 traces; A23, A27 and A28 similarly now precede A24/A25 and A29). [REL017, REL019, REL023, REL027, REL029, REL034, REL038, REL040, REL042, POS003, POS004, POS007, POS010, POS013, POS014]

- Successors in the later part of the process changed accordingly: A19, A23, A26, A27 and A28 previously led almost exclusively to A34 (about 90–98 in 100 outgoing transitions) and now lead almost exclusively to A29 (about 89–93 in 100); A33 and A44 now lead mainly to the A20–A25 activities where previously they led to A19/A23/A26/A27/A28. [DIR005, DIR009, DIR012, DIR013, DIR014, DIR015, DIR016]

- A04 became rarer (about 18 in 100 traces before, about 6 in 100 after), and A15 runs slightly later (mean relative position about 0.19 before, about 0.21 after). [OCC001, POS002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, A06 became a standard early step executed between A14 and A15: it appears in about 72 in 100 traces (up from about 17), A14 is typically followed immediately by A06, and A06 is typically followed by A15, so the direct A14→A15 succession largely disappeared. This rests on direct relational evidence — the successor profiles of A14 and A06, the co-occurrence and order of A06 with A14 and A15, and the shift of the A14→A15 distance from one step to two — all based on substantial observations in both windows. The 105 qualifying items far exceed the roughly 1 expected by chance, so the pattern as a whole is unlikely to be a sampling artefact; however, the many A06-centred items describe largely the same traces rather than independent confirmations, and several lag items resting on only 1–3 observations were not relied upon. The evidence cannot show whether A06 is a newly added step or an existing rare path that became frequent. [OCC002, DIR002, DIR004, REL001, REL002, LAG003, LAG004, POS001]

Other differences: the later sequence was reordered — the segment A19, A23, A26, A27, A28, A29, A33, which previously ran after the A20–A25 block, now runs before it, with near-complete reversal of the pairwise orders and matching successor changes (these activities now lead to A29 instead of A34); A04 became rarer; A15 runs slightly later. The evidence cannot establish whether this reordering is part of the same change as the A06 insertion or a separate one. [REL019, REL023, REL027, REL029, REL034, REL038, POS003, POS004, POS007, POS010, POS013, POS014, DIR005, DIR009, DIR012, DIR013, DIR014, DIR015, OCC001, POS002]
